SyncNative.Name: Apply profiles to native walls
SyncNative.Hint: When enabled, attaching a Threshold profile rewrites the wall's native movement, sight, light, sound and door settings. Disable to store profiles as metadata only.

Debug.Name: Threshold Debug Logging
Debug.Hint: Enable verbose logging for Threshold development.

DurabilityBars.Name: Durability bars on the map
DurabilityBars.Hint: Who sees durability bars over destructible barriers. Players see a bar only when they can see that spot.

Config.ProfileHint: Choosing a profile fills in the settings below.
Config.ChannelsHint: Base values for the closed barrier. Open, ajar and damaged states adjust them automatically.
Config.ThresholdsHint: In grid squares; the value in scene units is shown below each field. Used only by channels set to Proximity or Distance (in any state).
Config.AttenuationHint: Light and sound passing the proximity range fade gradually.
Config.PreviewNone: No profile: this is a plain Foundry wall.
Config.ManagedNotice: Movement, sight, light, sound and door settings are controlled by the Threshold profile “{profile}”. Change them on the Threshold tab.
Config.RemoveNotice: Saving will remove the Threshold profile and restore this wall's original settings.
Config.MetadataOnly: Applying profiles to native walls is turned off in module settings: the profile is stored as data only.
Config.OverridesHint: Change what gets through when the barrier is open, ajar, locked or damaged. “Default” follows the built-in rule shown in brackets.

OverrideHint.open: Without overrides an open barrier lets everything through. Override to keep something blocked, e.g. a window with curtains drawn back still blocks movement.
OverrideHint.ajar: Without overrides each channel becomes the less restrictive of the closed value and a narrow gap.
OverrideHint.locked: Without overrides a locked door behaves like a closed one.
OverrideHint.damaged: Without overrides a damaged barrier behaves like a closed one. Override to describe a broken window or a breached barricade.

Config.DoorOnlyState: Only available when Door control is set to Door or Secret door.
Config.NoDurability: No maximum durability: this barrier cannot be damaged.
Config.DurabilityHint: Leave Current empty for full durability. At 0 the barrier switches to the Damaged state.
Config.AppearanceHint: How the barrier looks on the map. Pick a bundled texture or any image of your own.
Config.DoorAppearanceHint: Doors use Foundry's animated door: the texture moves when the door opens.

Error.Invalid: Threshold: the wall was not saved. {error}
